notes: Wall clock is the only valid measure of the prefix-reuse win: the endpoint reports usage.prompt_tokens as N x prefix (no cache discount), so token counts are ~equal on both paths (specs/M1.md §1).

Baseline = one independent /completions request per question, sent sequentially to the same server; optimised = one request with `prompt` as an array. The server's radix cache also persists across separate requests, so the ratio measures batched-vs-sequential against this server, not a cache-disabled upper bound.
No warmup request was issued on either path (nothing was removed to inflate the ratio); the first sample of each path is visible in raw_ms.
speedup basis: total wall clock of the 63 fresh requests divided by the total wall clock of the 3 batched requests, for the same 63 decisions.
raw latencies: fresh = 63 per-question samples, shared-prefix = 3 per-batch samples (divide by 21 for the per-decision cost).
